title: Announcement Nov 28, 2023 Introducing OrbAI 1.0.6 OrbAI 1.0.6 introduces powerful new analytics tools and improved accessibility upgrades to refine your workflows. Here's what’s new:
summary: Synthetic Society is building synthetic users to automate end-to-end QA and UX testing, enabling rapid bug detection and superior user experiences.
body_markdown:
